game_of_the_day.name: Lara World
game_of_the_day.pitch: Race across five themed worlds, answer quiz questions, and beat arcade minigames like Dino Runner and Dragon Defense, solo or versus a bot.

games.name: KoboldAI Lite: AI Adventure
games.blurb: Text adventures where your AI is the game master: bring Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or a free volunteer model.
games.pitch: Pick a UI style, then co-write open-ended text adventures with an AI game master that improvises any story, character or scenario you imagine.

games.name: Iridium Reach
games.blurb: Dogfight from the cockpit of a starship among asteroids and stations.
games.pitch: Pilot a starship cockpit with a radar display and HUD readouts, hunting enemies through asteroid fields and around space stations beneath a nebula sky.

games.name: HELLGRID
games.blurb: Retro first-person shooter: fight through three sectors to close the rift. Every texture and sound is made in code.
games.pitch: Fight through three reactor sectors in a first-person shooter, with textures and sound all generated in code, until the rift gate opens.

games.name: Starfall Scavenger
games.blurb: Neon survivors-style roguelite: auto-fire, pick upgrades, beat the bosses across four acts.
games.pitch: Drift through a neon debris field with auto-firing weapons, collecting upgrades and fighting bosses across four acts in short roguelite runs.

games.name: GRIDX
games.blurb: Neon twin-stick shooter on a curved grid. Survive the waves and take down each boss.
games.pitch: Auto-firing twin-stick action on a curved neon grid, with a boss countdown, sub-weapon ultimates and swappable weapons adding some tactical variety.

games.name: LLM Chess Arena
games.blurb: Play chess against your own AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) and read why it makes every move.
games.pitch: Play a standard chess game against an AI opponent and read its written reasoning for each move, which turns every game into a lesson.

games.name: AI Overlord
games.blurb: A space shooter where an AI running in your browser designs every enemy wave and taunts you.
games.pitch: An in-browser language model invents each enemy wave's pattern, speed and swarm size, then taunts you while your auto-firing ship dodges.

games.name: Neon Vanguard
games.blurb: Retro vertical shoot-'em-up: steer your ship, auto-fire and clear the waves.
games.pitch: Steer a small ship through a starfield, auto-firing at diamond-shaped enemies while chasing a score, though the screenshots show little variety yet.

games.name: Yet Another Idle RPG
games.blurb: Explore locations, fight enemies, train skills and manage gear as your hero progresses.
games.pitch: Fight enemies, explore locations, train skills and progress an idle character.

games.name: Chain Net Crew: Basketball Shootout for Your AI Agents
games.blurb: Your coding agents shoot hoops on a night street court; you shoot too.
games.pitch: Your coding agents' tool calls become dunks, layups and bricks on a night court while you time your own green-release shots.

games.name: Ugh Guys
games.blurb: Choose a faction, gather resources, train units and destroy an AI opponent through fog of war.
games.pitch: Pick one of three factions and fight an AI opponent through fog of war.

games.name: Bolt Twist
games.blurb: Unscrew the bolts in the right order and clear the board.
games.pitch: Tap colored bolts to unscrew them into matching boxes or a limited tray, planning removal order so plates drop and the tray never fills.

Puzzle.name: Dead Slow
Puzzle.pitch: Neutral is not a brake: guide heavy ships to dock across 84 stages in seas, vacuum, and hamster balls.

Puzzle.name: Unirush
Puzzle.pitch: Snake where you must eat colours in rainbow order, lure zombies into your trail, and ride rainbow bridges through seven worlds.

Puzzle.name: Caldera Minesweeper
Puzzle.pitch: Minesweeper with no-guess boards, daily challenges, a hint solver, replays, speedrun stats, and themes, playable on mobile or offline.

Arcade.name: Raincoil
Arcade.pitch: Steer a living coil through colored rain, match three or more colors to burst them, and survive a three-minute storm.

Arcade.name: Boplicity
Arcade.pitch: Improvise bebop solos over a live rhythm section and get scored in real time on your jazz vocabulary.

Arcade.name: Lara World
Arcade.pitch: Race across five themed worlds, answer quiz questions, and beat arcade minigames like Dino Runner and Dragon Defense, solo or versus a bot.

Action.name: Space Game
Action.pitch: Blast through endless waves of enemies, swap and upgrade four weapons, and survive multi-phase bullet-hell boss fights.

Action.name: Lightcone
Action.pitch: Hide from an AI hunter that rewrites its own pursuit code mid-chase, using decoys, walls, and noise.

Action.name: Soladroid
Action.pitch: Possess hostile machines, win circuit duels, and fight down twenty decks to confront the ship's controlling AI.

Racing.name: Microkarts
Racing.pitch: Drift around a dinner-table circuit in tiny karts, grab items, and race friends online in 3D.

Racing.name: FunGame
Racing.pitch: Race 3D karts with 19 items on three big maps, playing solo against bots or online with friends.

Racing.name: Lapwise: 3D Grand Prix Racing Game for Your AI Agents
Racing.pitch: Your coding agents' real tool calls, commits and deploys drive a team of cars around a 3D track while you engineer and race.

Strategy.name: CSS Tower Defense
Strategy.pitch: Defend Aotearoa with Maori-themed guardians in a CSS-only 3D isometric world, with daily challenges, leaderboards, and cloud saves.

Strategy.name: Token Cart Tycoon
Strategy.pitch: Grow a hot dog cart into an AI startup in 30 days, balancing pricing, compute, and chaotic incidents.

Strategy.name: UnicornNight
Strategy.pitch: Place unicorns, steal stars, and cut the monster's line across eight distinct boards to save a child's dream.

3D.name: Buddy Rollback
3D.pitch: Fight through five glitchy software-themed realms as Buddy, building boons and defeating bosses in a Hades II-inspired roguelite.

3D.name: Nova Lancer
3D.pitch: Pilot a Star Fox-style fighter through sunset seas, canyons and neon fortresses, then battle a giant mechanical sea serpent boss.

3D.name: Forager
3D.pitch: Fly as a honeybee through a procedural 3D meadow, decode the waggle dance, dodge predators, and see in ultraviolet.

Idle.name: Yet Another Idle RPG
Idle.pitch: Fight enemies, explore locations, train skills and progress an idle character.

Idle.name: Bonk Box
Idle.pitch: Fling, firework and flatten a ragdoll stickman, earn coins, unlock toys and hats, and keep a daily streak going.

Idle.name: Viral Den
Idle.pitch: Tap to film clips and watch followers climb while cash buys camera, lights, room and gear upgrades that visibly transform your streamer room across levels.

Sports.name: Chain Net Crew: Basketball Shootout for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Your coding agents' tool calls become dunks, layups and bricks on a night court while you time your own green-release shots.

Sports.name: Kickoff Crew: Football Match for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Your coding agents become football players, with their tool calls driving passes and shots while you coach through tactics, pep talks and timed finishes.

Sports.name: Pin Pals: Bowling League for Your AI Agents
Sports.pitch: Bowl lane 1 with flick-aimed hook shots while your AI coding agents roll their own lanes, with task results deciding strikes, splits and turkey bonuses.

Word & Math.name: Letterloom: Anagram Crossword Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: Swipe around a letter wheel to spell words and fill a crossword grid, with daily puzzles, hints, bonus words and scenic levels.

Word & Math.name: Ninefold: Daily Sudoku Puzzle
Word & Math.pitch: A clean, classic sudoku with four difficulty tiers, pencil notes, hints and undo, plus a daily puzzle everyone shares and a mistake limit.

Word & Math.name: KoboldAI Lite: AI Adventure
Word & Math.pitch: Pick a UI style, then co-write open-ended text adventures with an AI game master that improvises any story, character or scenario you imagine.

Makeover.name: Tip Top: Nail Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Fill each client's order by choosing a nail shape, filing, polishing and stamping art, then see the whole hand finished in that look.

Makeover.name: Spin Bakes: Cake Decorating Game
Makeover.pitch: Hold to pipe textured icing rings onto a spinning cake, switch colours per layer, smooth it, and shake on toppings to match each customer's order.

Makeover.name: Snip Studio: Hair Salon Makeover
Makeover.pitch: Wash, cut, dye and style a client's hair to match a reference look, with funny client requests driving each short level.

Retro.name: SkiFree.js
Retro.pitch: Weave a skier downhill past trees and jumps while a yeti hunts you, in a simple endless chase that rewards quick reflexes.

Retro.name: Tank War
Retro.pitch: Defend your base and destroy enemy tanks in a top-down arcade battle.

Retro.name: Asteroids
Retro.pitch: Rotate and thrust a small triangular ship through drifting vector rocks, shooting them apart while dodging fragments in a faithful, stripped-down arcade loop.

Kids.name: Peekaboo Pals: Animal Memory Match
Kids.pitch: Peek at the animal cards, then flip them to find matching pairs on a table that grows each level, with hearts for mistakes.

Kids.name: Boop Board: Bubble Popper Fidget Game
Kids.pitch: Press or swipe across bubbles on squishy rainbow critter boards to pop them all before the sun-clock runs out, with some bubbles puffing back up.

Kids.name: Sudsy Lane: Kids Car Wash Game
Kids.pitch: Rub muddy toy trucks clean with a sponge, rinse and dry them, then add stickers, with a new vehicle each level.
